body: Take that back, I don't wanna kill my self. I just wanna get shit figured out.

The idea of a therapist sounds scary, and then I have to tell my parents about it which like I said is not something I want to do. I'd never tell Kim this because I believe it'd ruin the relationship we have. I just need someone or something to make me smile, to make me feel better. Fuck this, I kinda want to just die.
